summary: R5 fixed in code/futbt/walkforward.py with reproduce-first evidence: at base eae8c3d2 the co-owner case (weekday calendar 2026-01-01..2026-06-30 = 129 sessions, 4 folds, train_frac 0.7, horizon 2) planned fold1 test window 2026-05-08..2026-05-20 but apply_purge_embargo emitted TEST cells through 2026-06-30 (38 cells, 29 excess sessions, 29-session overlap with fold2, 31 label-immature cells kept) — reproduced as failing tests (12 failures + 1 error at pure base). Fix enforces per-window integrity: test_end enforced (post-test cells excluded from the fold and audited out_of_fold/POST_TEST_WINDOW), label maturity (test cells whose horizon extends past the fold boundary or the calendar end are dropped/censored LABEL_CENSORED, never truncated silently), purge >= true horizon kept (validation moved BEFORE any fold mutation), planner is the single horizon authority (mismatched Fold.true_horizon_sessions refused), NO overlapping folds (WalkForwardPlanner.validate_no_overlap in plan; emitted cell sets disjoint), final fold test window extended to calendar end (coverage completion only, never performance-based; 'no fold-total-floor suppression' law intact). After fix the same fold1 emits exactly 7 evaluated cells 2026-05-08..2026-05-18 with 2 LABEL_CENSORED (May 19/20), 1 PURGE, 29 POST_TEST_WINDOW; fold4 window reaches 2026-06-30 with its last 2 cells censored. New PIT producer-prefix tests truncate/mutate ALL producer channels (bars + roll table REBUILT via RollEngine from truncated bars + per-session metadata + nested TRAIN selection inputs): honest replay reproduces the decision prefix on the truncated producer and post-cutoff garbage in every channel changes nothing at or before the cutoff; counter-lookahead tests prove teeth (leaky bar/roll-table/metadata/selection implementations are each caught). README gains a typed WF/PIT disclosures section (IMPLEMENTED/TESTED/NOT_IMPLEMENTED one-liners incl. date-asof vs timestamp-release = NOT_IMPLEMENTED). Full suite 211 OK twice (147 base + 29 WF-PIT-FIX + 35 concurrent EXEC-FIX).
